hints.content: There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $r$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }r&=-3
\\\\
\text{larger }r&=12
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(\dfrac{9}{2},\dfrac{225}{4}\right)$

question.content:
$f(r)=-(r-12)(r+3)$

**1) What are the zeros of the function?**
